# CO24

> > CO24 delivers comprehensive Canadian news coverage spanning politics, crime, social issues, and community stories across Alberta, Quebec, Ontario, and national affairs.

CO24 is a bilingual Canadian news platform covering breaking news, political developments, social policy debates, and community initiatives. The site focuses on stories impacting Canadian communities from local crime reports to national trade negotiations, with particular emphasis on Alberta politics, food security, and cross-border relations.

## Key Topics

- Canadian Politics
- Alberta Government & UCP
- CUSMA Trade Relations
- Canada-US Relations
- Food Security & Food Banks
- Crime & Public Safety
- Social Justice & Reconciliation
- Healthcare Policy
- Political Leadership (Poilievre, Carney)
- Edmonton & Calgary News
- Quebec Provincial Affairs
- Community Support Initiatives
- Indigenous Issues
- Mental Health Services
- Bilingual News Coverage (English/French)
